mapper.insert: MERGE INTO RECON_BATCH T USING (SELECT #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BATCH_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.BATCH_ID = S.BATCH_ID) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BATCH_ID, BUSINESS_DATE, WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{businessDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{windowStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{windowEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'CREATED', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT BATCH_ID, BUSINESS_DATE, WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM ( SELECT BATCH_ID, BUSINESS_DATE, WINDOW_START, WINDOW_END, STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM RECON_BATCH WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('SUCCESS') ORDER BY CREATED_AT ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
